evidence: The composition and density of the TiN films were determined from Rutherford Backscattering Spectrometry (RBS). RBS used a 1 MeV He source with a backscattering angle of 135°. Impurities incorporation and compositional profiles in thin films were measured by secondary ion mass spectroscopy (SIMS, Cameca IMS 5F Ion spectrometer). For microstructure analysis, a Bruker diffractometer equipped with a CuKα source radiation was used. HRTEM images were obtained by using a JEOL 2010FX microscope. The high frequency capacitance–voltage (C–V) characteristic was measured at 1 and 100 kHz frequencies.
